summary: Camtek Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a First Amendment to its Second Amended and Restated Registration Rights Agreement with Priortech Ltd. and Chroma ATE Inc. The amendment extends the agreement by five years to June 18, 2031, and lowers the demand registration threshold to 1% of outstanding share capital. The change is a routine contractual housekeeping matter, not a transformative special situation. It requires only corporate approvals. There are no deal terms, no premium, no transaction price, and no involvement of advisors. No risk-arb angle exists; the filing merely updates registration mechanics for existing shareholders.
